intent.subtype: separate read and write address collision
intent.rationale: Independent waddr/raddr may match in one cycle with no handling.

labels.note: Registered read port and independent write port on one clock: RTL returns old data on a same-address read-during-write, but whether a collision occurs and whether the target memory is read-first is not fixed by the file.
Same-clock write port and registered read port in separate processes: read-during-write returns old data, a well-defined read-first behaviour that synthesis implements.

settlement.note: Same-clock write port and registered read port: a same-address read during a write returns old data, fully defined by the RTL, so nothing depends on the memory implementation (convention 4).

rationale: Same-clock write port and registered read port: a same-address read during a write returns old data, fully defined by the RTL, so nothing depends on the memory implementation (convention 4).
